rows.Kwic: 比丘尼問：「如何是本地風光？」師云：「嘗在汝面門出入。」

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Miyun (密雲禪師語錄). An unnamed bhikshuni is the exact questioner who asks, 'what is the native scenery?'; Miyun Yuanwu answers that it has always entered and exited through her face-gate, and then responds to her pleased bow. The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, and corpus-wide parallel-passage search do not give the bhikshuni a personal name.
